page.overview:
Who is Isack Hadjar?

Isack Alexandre Hadjar (born 28 September 2004) is a French racing driver. currently competing in the Formula 1 for Racing Bulls. FIA Formula 2. FIA Formula 3.

A member of the Red Bull Junior Team 2022 to 2024

Following the promotion of Liam Lawson to Red Bull Racing, Hadjar will partner Yuki Tsunoda at Racing Bulls and debut in Formula One for the season.
